summary.intent: Execute Phase 40 of cipher-box, integrating desktop vault settings by deriving HKDF keypairs and wiring configurable FUSE operation parameters into the desktop auth flow.
summary.outcome: Phase 40 completed successfully with 2/2 plans executed and 9/9 must-haves verified. HKDF vault settings derivation, VaultSettings domain type, desktop auth flow loading, and FUSE constant replacement are all live on the feature branch.

repo: Versioning logic (MAX_VERSIONS_PER_FILE, VERSION_COOLDOWN_MS) lives in shared files crates/fuse/src/read_ops.rs (macOS+Linux) and crates/fuse/src/platform/windows/write_ops.rs — not in platform shims.
crates/fuse/src/platform/linux.rs and platform/macos.rs are thin shims for mount flags and signal handling only.
apps/desktop currently targets macOS and Windows only — no Linux desktop launcher exists yet, but the underlying FUSE library code (read_ops.rs, mount_filesystem) covers Linux.
The shared mount_filesystem function at apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/fuse/mod.rs:50 serves both macOS and Linux via the fuse feature flag.
Phase 40 has no formal REQ-IDs — it is a follow-up to Phase 39 with goal-driven coverage only.
HKDF vault settings derivation uses info string 'cipherbox-vault-settings-v1', consistent with the pattern of the 5 existing derivation functions in the crypto crate.
VaultSettings struct uses serde camelCase deserialization with validation/clamping, and cross-language test vector parity against TypeScript.

code.finding: mount_filesystem is shared between macOS and Linux — changes here cover both platforms implicitly.

workflow: Worktree merges can land on detached/different branches; cherry-picking commits to the feature branch is needed when the worktree branch diverges.
The gsd-tools verify key-links command reports false negatives for patterns that will be created by the current wave — safe to proceed when target files confirmed to exist.
Wave 2 pre-dependency checks on files not yet created by the current wave should be ignored; only prior-wave artifacts need verification.

friction: Wave 2 worktree commits landed on a detached/different branch instead of merging cleanly, requiring a manual cherry-pick step.
An incorrect claim was made in conversation that Linux FUSE was not covered, requiring investigation and correction before phase could proceed — verification passed regardless.
open_items: Linux desktop app launcher does not exist yet — Linux FUSE library support is present but the desktop app does not ship a Linux build.
HUMAN-UAT.md was not created (verification passed automated checks fully) — no manual testing items were deferred.
